summary.text: The Arizona Capitol Times reported in December 2024 that Anna Abeytia would take the Legislative District 24 House seat held by Analise Ortiz, who was moving to the Senate.

paragraphs.text: According to the Capitol Times, she was president of the Cartwright Elementary School District Governing Board at the time and lost her bid for re-election to that board in November 2024.
The Capitol Times describes her as an educator who has held positions in the Cartwright and Glendale school districts, and says she was born and raised in Maryvale.
